content.facts: Secondary-victim claims are controlled by proximity requirements; primary victims face a different duty analysis.
questionsBeforeCourt: What legal rule governs the doctrine?
content.ratioDecidendi: A secondary victim may recover for a recognised psychiatric injury after seeing injured family in the immediate aftermath. Proximity of relationship, time and space, and direct perception control the claim. Citation already in this file: [1983] 1 AC 410.
content.holding: Secondary-victim claims are controlled by proximity requirements; primary victims face a different duty analysis.
content.relevance: Use the case for its stated ratio and apply it to the proved facts.
